Transformation

You gain the full strength of your dark ki combined with your Super Saiyan State. Awakening an enhanced version of Super Saiyan 3 with red eyes as opposed to blue eyes and a darkened ki. You must have the “Dark Ki” Power-Up Active in order to transform

  • +4 Power Bonus
  • You deal +1d10 to all Damage Rolls
  • Increase all Movement Speed by 20 Ft.
  • When you would cast a Technique, you may spend an amount of stamina equal to half the ki rank, changing the damage type to necrotic.
  • 5 Stamina Upkeep
